existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `TerminologyCapabilities` has material local breaking changes despite stable artifact identity. The top migration concerns are the `codeSearch` code-system replacement, mandatory `codeSystem.content`, stricter code-system uniqueness/default constraints, and removal of `closure`. The main uncertainty is semantic mapping for old `codeSearch` and `$closure` behavior without official diff notes or operation narrative.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should validate old instances against the new R6 constraints rather than relying on structural name matching. Systems need a policy for removed `closure`, a manual or rules-based mapping for `codeSearch`, a way to populate `codeSystem.content`, deduplication of `codeSystem` entries and version defaults, and extensions or loss annotations for R6-only supplement and canonical-resource metadata when down-converting to R4.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural and binding deltas because both core StructureDefinitions and the local CodeSystems/ValueSets were available. Confidence is lower for semantic intent and best mappings because no official diff, JIRA rationale, narrative pages, or ConceptMaps were available locally.

topFindings.title: Each R6 codeSystem entry must now declare content mode
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid plus R6-to-R4 loss: R4 `codeSystem` repetitions without `content` fail R6, while R6 content-mode assertions have no native R4 field.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: codeSearch required codes were replaced
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and R6-to-R4 loss: old required-binding codes are invalid in R6, new required-binding codes are invalid in R4, and generated enums/switch logic need changes.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds error constraints requiring distinct code-system and version declarations
